# Project Setup

```{r}
#| label:  setup

cran <- c("parallel", "sommer")
git <- c("hemstrow/snpR") # https://github.com/hemstrow/snpR

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  for (pkg in cran) { 
    if( !require(pkg, character.only = TRUE) ) {
      install.packages(pkg)
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    } 
  }
  
  for (pkg in git) {
    if( !require(sub(".*/", "", pkg), character.only = TRUE) ) {
      devtools::install_github(pkg, upgrade = TRUE)
      library(sub(".*/", "", pkg), character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }
}); remove(cran, git, pkg)

# remotes::install_github("hemstrow/snpR", ref = "dev")

ncores <- floor(parallel::detectCores()*0.8)
set.seed(2025)

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')

cat("Project: ", getwd(), "\n")
session_info()
```

For the large files was created a `xclude` folder and add the name to the `.gitignore` to avoid upload files saved in this folder to the server

# Phenotypic data

```{r}
url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WQKAOnxO9on7YoF9yC2WV7eHcChZJ5FR6DVyg0tJK1o/edit#gid=0"
gs <- url %>% as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>%
  range_read("phenotype") %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(trial, pop, num, type, rlw_flw:w2l_mtr)) %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(line
                       , delim = "_"
                       , names = c("cross", "nline")
                       , cols_remove = FALSE
                       , too_few = "align_start"
                       ) %>% 
  mutate(pop = case_when(
    str_detect(cross, "SALx", ) ~ "SAL"
    , str_detect(cross, "xKAN", ) ~ "KAN"
    , .default = cross
  ), .before = "cross")
  

fb %>% web_table(caption = "Phenotypic data")
```

```{r}
fbdist <- fb %>% 
  drop_na(nline) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(pop:line), names_to = "trait") %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(trait
                       , delim = "_"
                       , names = c("variable", "phenology")
                       , cols_remove = FALSE
                       ) %>% 
  mutate(phenology = case_when(
    phenology %in% "flw" ~ "flowering" 
    , phenology %in% "mtr" ~ "maturity"
    , phenology %in% "hrv" ~ "harvest"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(variable = case_when(
    variable %in% "ndflw" ~ "Flowering (days)" 
    , variable %in% "plth" ~ "Plant height (cm)"
    , variable %in% "pnlg" ~ "Panicle lenght (cm)"
    , variable %in% "pnwd" ~ "Panicle width (cm)"
    , variable %in% "mstd" ~ "Mean stem diameter (cm)"
    , variable %in% "ndpm" ~ "Physiological maturity (days)"
    , variable %in% "sdyp" ~ "Yield by plant (g)"
    , variable %in% "yplt" ~ "Yield by 10 plants (g)"
    , variable %in% "yield" ~ "Yield (Tn/ha)"
  )) %>% 
  unite("label", c(variable, phenology), sep = "\nStage: ", remove = F)

fbdist$trait %>% unique() %>% dput()

order <- c("ndflw_flw"
           , "plth_flw"
           , "pnlg_flw", "pnwd_flw"
           , "ndpm_mtr"
           , "plth_mtr"
           , "pnlg_mtr", "pnwd_mtr"
           , "mstd_mtr"
           , "sdyp_hrv", "yplt_hrv", "yield_hrv")

lb <- fbdist %>% 
  dplyr::select(trait, label) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  deframe()

dist <- fbdist %>% 
  mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels = order)) %>% 
  arrange(trait) %>% 
  plot_raw(type = "box"
         , x = "pop"
         , y = "value"
         , legend = "none"
         , xlab = "Population"
         , ylab = ""
           ) +
  facet_wrap(~ trait, scales = "free_y"
             , labeller = as_labeller(lb)
             , nrow = 3
             ) + 
  geom_violin(trim=FALSE)+
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1)

dist$layers[[1]] <- NULL
dist$layers[[1]] <- NULL

fig <- dist %>% 
  ggsave2(filename = "manuscript/dist.jpg"
          , units = "cm", width = 30, height = 15)

fig %>% include_graphics()
```

# Genotypic data

Genotypic data is in a BCF file which has more than 2 Gb large and harbors >900.000 SNPs. In order to keep the running times manageable, the number of SNPs has to be reduce.

The snp pruning were performed in the server of the Crop Biodiversity and Breeding Informatics groups at University of Hohenheim.

```{bash}
#| eval: false

ssh flaaw57@server231.ipsp.uni-hohenheim.de
cd /work/workspaces/novogene-sequencing-job-2021/vcfs/
cd /work/workspaces/flavio/quinoagenetics/

# -e stands for "exclude." It removes variants that meet the specified condition.
# F_MISSING refers to the fraction of missing data at a variant site.
# > 0.5 means any variants where more than 50% of the data are missing will be excluded (filtered out).

bcftools filter -e 'F_MISSING > 0.5' -O z /work/workspaces/novogene-sequencing-job-2021/vcfs/quinoa_run1_all.bcf > /work/workspaces/flavio/quinoagenetics/quinoa.vcf.gz

# export names to rename
bcftools query -l quinoa.vcf.gz > genotype_names.txt
```

## Genotypes names to rename vcf file

```{r}
#| eval: false

vcf.names <- "quinoa4gwas/genotype_names.txt" %>% 
  read.csv(header = F, col.names = "name_old") %>% 
  mutate(pmatch = toupper(name_old)) %>% 
  mutate(match = gsub(".*A(.+)_F.*", "\\1", pmatch)) %>% 
  select(!pmatch)

parents <- c("blanca de juli" = "BDJ"
             , "chulpi" = "CHU"
             , "ayrampo" = "AYR"
             , "choclito" = "CHO")

geno.names <- "quinoa4gwas/camacani_plots_cs-genotyping.xlsx" %>% 
  readxl::read_xlsx() %>% 
  mutate(cross = recode(cross, !!!parents)) %>% 
  unite(match, c(plots, crossn, line), remove = F, sep = "_") %>% 
  mutate(name_new = case_when(
    cross %in% c("SAL", "PAN", "HUA", "KCA", "COL", "BDJ", "CHU", "AYR", "CHO", "PAS") ~  as.character(paste(cross, line, crossn, sep = "_"))
    , TRUE ~ as.character(paste(cross, line, sep = "_"))
  )) %>% 
  select(match, name_new) 

vcf.rename <- merge(vcf.names, geno.names, by = "match", all.x = T) %>% 
  mutate(name_new = case_when(
    is.na(name_new) ~ name_old
    , TRUE ~ name_new
  )) %>% 
  select(!match) %>% 
  mutate(name_new = gsub("KCA", "KAN", name_new)) %>% 
  mutate(name_new = gsub("COL", "NCO", name_new))

tab <- vcf.rename %>% 
  distinct(name_new) 

vcf.rename %>% write_tsv("quinoa4gwas/vcf.rename.txt")
```

```{bash}

# Filter NAM populations for SAL and KAN

grep -E "SALx|xKAN" genotype_renamed.txt > populations.txt

# SNPs for all populations

bcftools view -S populations.txt quinoa_rhd.vcf.gz > quinoa_pops.vcf.gz
```

# snpR

- https://www.nature.com/articles/s41576-024-00738-6/tables/1

```{r}
# vcffile <- choose.files()

vcfile <- "G:\\Mi unidad\\coding\\quinoa4gwas\\quinoa_pops.vcf.gz"

snpdt <- snpR::read_vcf(file = vcfile)
snpdt

sample_meta <- snpdt %>% 
  names() %>% 
  gsub("_.*", "", .) %>% 
  enframe(value = "cross") %>% 
  mutate(pop = case_when(
    str_detect(cross, "xKAN") ~ "KAN"
    , str_detect(cross, "KAN") ~ "KAN"
    , str_detect(cross, "SALx") ~ "SAL"
    , str_detect(cross, "SAL") ~ "SAL"
  ))
  
sample.meta(snpdt)$cross <- factor(sample_meta$cross
                                   , levels = c("HUAxKAN", "NCOxKAN", "PASxKAN"
                                                , "SALxHUA", "SALxNCO", "SALxPAN"))
sample.meta(snpdt)$pop <- sample_meta$pop

sample.meta(snpdt)
snp.meta(snpdt)
```

# Clean genotyping data

```{r}
# Minor allele frequency of 0.05
# Minimum individuals 50%
# At least 50% of loci sequenced per individual.

snpdt_filt <- snpR::filter_snps(x = snpdt
                              , maf = 0.05
                              , min_ind = 0.5
                              , min_loci = 0.3
                              , maf_facets = "cross"
                              )

snpR::filters(snpdt_filt)
```

# Export data

```{r}
sample.meta(snpdt_filt)
snp.meta(snpdt_filt)

vcfdt <- format_snps(x = snpdt_filt
                     , output = "vcf"
                     , chr = "CHROM"
                     , position = "position"
                     , facets = "pop"
                     , verbose = TRUE
                     , outfile = "quinoa4gwas/pops/nam"
                     )

snpR::citations(snpdt_filt)
snpR::filters(snpdt_filt)

vcfdt <- format_snps(x = snpdt_filt
                     , output = "vcf"
                     , chr = "CHROM"
                     , position = "position"
                     , verbose = TRUE
                     , outfile = "quinoa4gwas/pops/quinoa.vcf"
                     )
```

# Objectives

## (i) Assess the inter and intra-population genetic differentiation of the NAM populations

- Fig 1: (a) PCA, (b) POPstructure, (c) FST,  and (d) LD by NAM pop
  - SFig: PCA completo
- Table with diversity value for NAM pop

### PCA

```{r}
pca <- plot_clusters(snpdt_filt, facets = c("pop.cross")
                     , check_duplicates = TRUE
                     , plot_type = "pca"
                     , shape_has_more_levels = FALSE 
                     )

paleta <- c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#e7298a", "#66a61e", "#e6ab02")

p1a <- pca$plots$pca +
  geom_point(aes(shape = pop, color = cross), size = 1.7) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("KAN" = 16, "SAL" = 17)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = paleta) +
  labs(
    color = "Cross",
    shape = "Population"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p1a
```

### Population structure

```{r}
#| cache: true

popstr_k <- snpR::plot_structure(x = snpdt_filt
                               , facet = "cross"
                               , k = 2:10
                               , method = "snmf"
                               , reps = 20
                               , clumpp = FALSE
                               , clumpp_path = "C:/CLUMPP/CLUMPP.exe"
                               )

plot_sfa <- popstr_k$plot

# Calcular la entropía cruzada promedio y desviación estándar por cada K
k_summary <- popstr_k$K_plot %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_entropy = mean(Cross.Entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_entropy = sd(Cross.Entropy, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Visualizar la curva de entropía cruzada
plot_sfb <- ggplot(k_summary, aes(x = k, y = mean_entropy)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Optimal K value selection with sNMF",
    x = "Number of clusters (K)",
    y = "Mean cross-entropy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_summary$k) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

list(plot_sfa + 
       scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Paired") + 
       theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
      )
     , plot_sfb 
     ) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.3)) %>% 
  ggsave2(plot = ., "manuscript/SFigure-01.jpg"
                 , width = 35, height = 30, units = "cm")

popstr <- snpR::plot_structure(x = snpdt_filt
                               , facet = "cross"
                               , k = 3
                               , method = "snmf"
                               , clumpp = FALSE
                               , reps = 1
                               )

p1b <- popstr$plot +
  scale_fill_brewer(type = "qua", palette = "Accent")

p1b
```

### LD decay

```{bash}
VCF=quinoa4gwas/pops/nam_KAN.vcf
RSL=quinoa4gwas/pops/ld_results_KAN

plink1 --vcf $VCF --r2 --ld-window 99999 --ld-window-kb 300 --ld-window-r2 0 --allow-extra-chr --out $RSL

VCF=quinoa4gwas/pops/nam_SAL.vcf
RSL=quinoa4gwas/pops/ld_results_SAL

plink1 --vcf $VCF --r2 --ld-window 99999 --ld-window-kb 300 --ld-window-r2 0 --allow-extra-chr --out $RSL
```

```{r}
# Cargar los datos y calcular distancia
ld_data_KAN <- read.table("quinoa4gwas/pops/ld_results_KAN.ld", header = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(pop = "KAN") 
ld_data_SAL <- read.table("quinoa4gwas/pops/ld_results_SAL.ld", header = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(pop = "SAL")

ld_data <- list(ld_data_KAN, ld_data_SAL) %>%
  bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(distance_kb = abs(BP_A - BP_B) / 1000)

# Filtrar a 300 kb
ld_data <- ld_data %>% 
  group_by(pop) %>% 
  filter(distance_kb <= 300)

ggplot(ld_data, aes(x = distance_kb, y = R2, color = pop)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, span = 0.1, size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Pairwise distance (kb)",
    y = expression(LD~(r^2))
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

### Diversity indices

```{r}
snpdt_filt <- calc_pi(snpdt_filt, "cross")
snpdt_filt <- calc_ho(snpdt_filt, "cross")
snpdt_filt <- calc_he(snpdt_filt, "cross")
snpdt_filt <- calc_fis(snpdt_filt, "cross")

stats <- get.snpR.stats(snpdt_filt, "cross"
                        , stats = c("pi", "he", "ho", "fis"))

tab <- stats$weighted.means %>% 
  dplyr::select(subfacet, starts_with("weighted")) 

tab %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub("weighted_mean_", "", .)) %>% 
  rename("Population" = subfacet) %>% 
  googlesheets4::sheet_write(ss = gs, "divindex")

#> genetic distance

snpdt_filt <- calc_genetic_distances(snpdt_filt, "cross")
get.snpR.stats(snpdt_filt, "cross", "genetic_distance")
```



## (ii) Map and characterize QTL to elucidate their roles in yield architecture and cross-reference them with prior genomic findings in quinoa

> rMVP: Memory-efficient, Visualization-enhanced, and Parallel-accelerated Genome-Wide Association Study

- https://github.com/xiaolei-lab/rMVP
- https://github.com/YinLiLin/CMplot

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(NAM)
library(vcfR)
library(CMplot)
library(rMVP)
```

### SALCEDO NAM

```{r}
pheno <- fb %>% 
  filter(grepl("SALx", line)) %>%
  dplyr::select(!c(pop, cross, nline)) %>%
  write_csv("quinoa4gwas//mlt-sal.csv")

MVP.Data(fileVCF = "quinoa4gwas/pop_SAL.vcf"
         , filePhe = "quinoa4gwas/mlt-sal.csv"
         , sep.phe = ","
         , priority = "speed"
         , fileKin = FALSE
         , filePC = FALSE
         , out = "quinoa4gwas/rmvp/dt_sal"
         , ncpus = ncores
         )
```

## Kinship

```{r}
MVP.Data.Kin(fileKin = TRUE
             , mvp_prefix = 'quinoa4gwas/rmvp/dt_sal'
             , out = 'quinoa4gwas/rmvp/kin_sal')
```

## Data input

```{r}
genotype <- attach.big.matrix("quinoa4gwas/rmvp/dt_sal.geno.desc")
phenotype <- read.table("quinoa4gwas/rmvp/dt_sal.phe", head = TRUE)
mapping <- read.table("quinoa4gwas/rmvp/dt_sal.geno.map", head = TRUE)
kinship <- attach.big.matrix("quinoa4gwas/rmvp/kin_sal.kin.desc")
```

##  GWAS

```{r}
mvp <- 2:length(phenotype) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  gc()  
  
  MVP(phe = phenotype %>% dplyr::select(1, all_of(x))
    , geno = genotype
    , map = mapping
    , K = kinship
    , vc.method = "EMMA"
    , method = c("FarmCPU")
    , maxLoop = 20
    , outpath = "quinoa4gwas/gwas/"
    , file.output = FALSE
    , file.type = "csv"
    , ncpus = ncores
    )
    
})

# FarmCPU p-values 

gwas_sal <- 1:length(mvp) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  bind_cols(mvp[[x]]$map, mvp[[x]]$farmcpu.results) %>% 
    dplyr::select(!c(Effect, SE)) %>% 
    rownames_to_column()
  
}) %>% 
  Reduce(function(...) merge(..., all = TRUE), .) %>% 
  arrange(as.numeric(rowname)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowname, REF, ALT)) %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub(".FarmCPU", "-SAL", .))
```

```{r}
pheno <- fb %>%
```

## Data input

##  GWAS

```{r}
mvp <- 2:length(phenotype) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  gc()  
  
  MVP(phe = phenotype %>% dplyr::select(1, all_of(x))
    , geno = genotype
    , map = mapping
    , K = kinship
    , vc.method = "EMMA"
    , method = c("FarmCPU")
    , maxLoop = 20
    , outpath = "quinoa4gwas/gwas/"
    , file.output = FALSE
    , file.type = "csv"
    , ncpus = ncores
    )
    
})

# FarmCPU p-values 

gwas_kan <- 1:length(mvp) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  bind_cols(mvp[[x]]$map, mvp[[x]]$farmcpu.results) %>% 
    dplyr::select(!c(Effect, SE)) %>% 
    rownames_to_column()
  
}) %>% 
  Reduce(function(...) merge(..., all = TRUE), .) %>% 
  arrange(as.numeric(rowname)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowname, REF, ALT)) %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub(".FarmCPU", "-KAN", .))
```

## Merge GWAS NAM populations

```{r}
gwas_rmvp <- base::merge(x = gwas_sal, y = gwas_kan
                  , by = c("SNP", "CHROM", "POS")
                  ) %>% 
  arrange(CHROM)
```

## SNP density-plot

```{r}
dsp <- ~ {
  
  CMplot(gwas_rmvp
       , plot.type = "d"
       , bin.size = 1e6
```

# NAM: Nested Association Mapping

- https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/NAM/index.html

## SALCEDO NAM

```{r}
pheno <- fb %>% 
  filter(grepl("SALx", line))

vcfdt  <- "quinoa4gwas/pop_SAL.vcf" %>% 
  vcfR::read.vcfR()

info <- vcfdt %>% 
  vcfR::getFIX() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(ID, ~ gsub("_", "",. ))) %>% 
  rowid_to_column()

chr <- info %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(chrome = gsub(".*([0-9]+[A-Z]+).*", "\\1", CHROM)) %>% 
  group_by(chrome) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  deframe()
  
gwsdt <- vcfdt %>% 
  extract.gt() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(.), ~ case_when(
    . %in% "1/1" ~ 2
    , . %in% "0/1" ~ 1
    , . %in% "1/0" ~ 1
    , . %in% "0/0" ~ 0
  ))) %>% 
  rownames_to_column() %>% 
  arrange(rowname) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!rowname, names_to = "geno", values_to = "col") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "rowname", values_from = "col") %>% 
  separate(geno, c("family", "line"), remove = F) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!line) %>% 
  mutate(fam = case_when(
    family %in% "SALxPAN" ~ 1
    , family %in% "SALxNCO" ~ 2
    , family %in% "SALxHUA" ~ 3
  ), .after = family) %>% 
  merge(., pheno, by.x = "geno", by.y = "line")

rsl <- (length(gwsdt) - 11):length(gwsdt) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  trait <- gwsdt[x]
  
  nam_gwas = gwas(y = trait
                , gen = gwsdt %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("SNP_"))
                , fam = gwsdt$fam
                , chr = chr
                )
  
  plot(nam_gwas, alpha = 0.05/nrow(info)
         , main = names(trait)
         ) %>% print
  
  nam_gwas$PolyTest %>% mutate(trait = names(trait)) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("ID")
  
}) 

gwas_sal_nam <- rsl %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, pval, trait) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = trait, values_from = pval) %>% 
  base::merge(info, ., by = "ID") %>% 
  arrange(rowid) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowid, REF:FILTER))
```

## KANCOLLA NAM

```{r}
pheno <- fb %>% 
  filter(grepl("xKAN", line))

vcfdt  <- "quinoa4gwas/pop_KAN.vcf" %>% 
  vcfR::read.vcfR()

info <- vcfdt %>% 
  vcfR::getFIX() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(ID, ~ gsub("_", "",. ))) %>% 
  rowid_to_column()

chr <- info %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(chrome = gsub(".*([0-9]+[A-Z]+).*", "\\1", CHROM)) %>% 
  group_by(chrome) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  deframe()
  
gwsdt <- vcfdt %>% 
  extract.gt() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(.), ~ case_when(
    . %in% "1/1" ~ 2
    , . %in% "0/1" ~ 1
    , . %in% "1/0" ~ 1
    , . %in% "0/0" ~ 0
  ))) %>% 
  rownames_to_column() %>% 
  arrange(rowname) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!rowname, names_to = "geno", values_to = "col") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "rowname", values_from = "col") %>% 
  separate(geno, c("family", "line"), remove = F) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!line) %>% 
  mutate(fam = case_when(
    family %in% "HUAxKAN" ~ 1
    , family %in% "NCOxKAN" ~ 2
    , family %in% "PASxKAN" ~ 3
  ), .after = family) %>% 
  merge(., pheno, by.x = "geno", by.y = "line")

rsl <- (length(gwsdt) - 11):length(gwsdt) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  trait <- gwsdt[x]
  
  nam_gwas = gwas(y = trait
                , gen = gwsdt %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("SNP_"))
                , fam = gwsdt$fam
                , chr = chr
                )
  
  plot(nam_gwas, alpha = 0.05/nrow(info)
         , main = names(trait)
         ) %>% print
  
  nam_gwas$PolyTest %>% mutate(trait = names(trait)) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("ID")
  
}) 

gwas_kan_nam <- rsl %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, pval, trait) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = trait, values_from = pval) %>% 
  base::merge(info, ., by = "ID") %>% 
  arrange(rowid) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowid, REF:FILTER))
```

## Merge GWAS NAM populations

```{r}
gwas_nam <- base::merge(x = gwas_sal_nam, y = gwas_kan_nam
                  , by = c("ID", "CHROM", "POS")
                  ) %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub(".x", "-SAL", .)) %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub(".y", "-KAN", .)) %>% 
  arrange(CHROM)
```

# LD decay

- https://speciationgenomics.github.io/ld_decay/

```{bash}
VCF=quinoa4gwas/pop_SAL.vcf

plink1 --vcf $VCF --double-id --allow-extra-chr \
--set-missing-var-ids @:# \
--thin 0.1 --r2 gz --ld-window 100 --ld-window-kb 5 \
--ld-window-r2 0 \
--out quinoa4gwas/ld_quinoa
```

```{r}
ld <- read.table("quinoa4gwas/ld_quinoa.ld.gz", header=TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(distance = BP_B - BP_A)

ggplot(ld, aes(x= distance, y = R2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth() +
  labs(x="Distance (bp)", y="LD (r²)", title="LD Decay Plot")


```

```{bash}
plink1 --vcf quinoa4gwas/pop_SAL.vcf --ld-window 99999 --ld-window-r2 0 --r2 --out quinoa4gwas/ld_quinoa --allow-extra-chr
```

```{r}
ld <- read.table("quinoa4gwas/ld_quinoa.ld", header=TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(distance = BP_B - BP_A)

ggplot(ld, aes(x= distance, y = R2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth() +
  labs(x="Distance (bp)", y="LD (r²)", title="LD Decay Plot")
```
